summary: Cotton commends Trump and Netanyahu on hostage release, frames conflict as Hamas threat to US and allies, pledges to 'never again allow Hamas to threaten the United States.'
quote: I commend President Trump and Prime Minister Netanyahu for this monumental achievement. We will not forget the deceased hostages…And we will never again allow Hamas to threaten the United States and our friends.

summary: Cotton states on C-SPAN that there is no evidence of genocide in the context of the Gaza conflict.
quote: We don't have any evidence of genocide.

summary: AJC documents Cotton introduced Israel Security Assistance Support Act (May 2024) to require weapons deliveries to Israel, pressed for expedited military aid, and advocated advanced capabilities vs. Iran.

summary: Cotton reintroduced PLO and PA Terror Payments Accountability Act to sanction Palestinian institutions for 'pay-for-slay' terror compensation, calling the program 'reprehensible.'
quote: The Palestinian Authority and the Palestine Liberation Organization continue to support terrorism against Israel by providing hundreds of millions of dollars per year in their reprehensible 'pay-for-slay' program.

summary: FEC filings show Cotton received $1,303,226 from pro-Israel PACs ($1,156,058 from AIPAC PAC/UDP), ranking #3 of 100 senators; 823 transactions through 2026-08-19.
